dataAndPrivacyDifferences.difference: Enabled-account counts and only-one-configured-account explanation are omitted; trace candidates are not configuration inventory.
Retained scalar routing evidence drives native descriptions; incomplete reasons say unavailable in the original explanation location.
Missing measurements and outcomes say unavailable; missing totals use an em dash rather than invented zero.
Stable opaque backend handles and neutral names replace raw account identities; mask only hides these neutral labels. External live quota windows are not read.

Recorded safe provider names and bundled icon/preset metadata retain native precedence; unavailable or unsupported metadata uses neutral/generic fallback. Private group/account identities remain opaque and settings navigation is removed, not stubbed.

Pinned built-in client labels/icons replace installed-client inventory. A separately disclosed project basename precedes the short session, including a single project; model and full session remain in the tooltip. No folder-to-project inference. Full folder metadata is separately opt-in.

Source-local child rows copy the pinned native nested-group presentation (routing.css lines 71-107), with depth-1 indentation, concrete observed models and request-only states. Opaque actor keys remain internal: no displayed IDs or numbering; one unknown-actor activity aggregate. No worker ancestry, task completion claim, extra source, wire, or flight endpoint. A list-wide disclosure and keyboard/touch scroll expose all retained entries; no added actor cap. Only this scoped extension uses plugin CSS; native CSS is byte-identical. New messages translate zh-TW and otherwise fall back to English.
Collected process identity is shown without a gateway URL; missing source clock blocks live playback. Group clock configuration is unavailable.
Recorded quota fields remain; provider-supplied display text, live windows, expiry inventory, currency preferences and exchange rates are not fetched. Native default number/USD formatting remains.
Authenticated bounded whole snapshots replace core polling; collector live status is not process ownership. Hidden/aborted/revoked and generation reset paths clear or pause native playback.
Fixed local images use anonymous CORS so native toneCheck canvas sampling works in the opaque-origin sandbox. Only Origin: null is allowed; no credentials or arbitrary icon URLs.
Original mask and replay retained; group editor links, usage/body actions, context cards and diagnostic-report actions excluded.
